Resolves #18696

The dense tour's first identity assertion counted every parent-less `Neo.state.Provider` and expected one, so the Workstation's second root failed it — and the second root turns out to be correct. `Neo.manager.Transaction#getProvider` creates one Provider per Group on first read, deliberately parent- and component-less so a popped-out window and its opener read the same `canUndo` / `canRedo`, and `retireGroup` destroys it with the Group. The arm now counts the roots that **own a component** (one, the workspace's — what the identity snapshot means) and separately requires the component-less roots to be exactly the topology Group's history Provider, resolved by id from the manager. A second, unexplained root still fails. Behind that count sat a second assertion no run had reached since #18560: `shortGeometry.scale.height >= 230` is unsatisfiable at a 600-tall viewport, because every band holds its rem floor there — asserted two lines above — so the center absorbs the whole delta and the grid is 216, not 230.

Evidence: L3 (mounted e2e against the external Brain runtime, headed and headless) → L3 required (AC-1 … AC-4). Residual: none.

## Deltas from ticket

Two, both recorded in the corrected ticket body.

**The ticket's premise was wrong and the diff is not what it asked for.** It argued the orphan was very likely a *destroyed* Provider still registered, and prescribed tapping `Neo.manager.Instance.register` / `unregister` and fixing the bookkeeping path. A temporary warn in `Provider#construct` — firing for any instance built with neither `component` nor `parent` — captured the real creator instead: `Transaction.getProvider` ← `TopologyToolbar.historyStepBadge`. The destroyed reading came from reading `destroy()`'s property fingerprint, and its discriminator did not discriminate: `isDestroyed` reads `undefined` on the two healthy Providers as well. No engine change was needed, and `Neo.manager.Transaction` is untouched.

**`:876` was taken in scope.** It is the same defect shape in the same arm, and it sits between the repaired assertion and any receipt that the repair holds.

`:1266` — the dark-mode splitter's `element.matches(':active')` after `mouse.down()` — is out of scope, noted in #17844.

All coverage here is outside CI: `WorkstationNL` needs `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT`, so the e2e job's selection drops it.

| run | reaches | verdict |

The pre-repair baseline is the ticket's own reproduction: `:664` fails `Expected: 1 / Received: 2` at `dev@474f4290c8`, headed and headless, and with origin/dev's own copy of the spec file.

Non-vacuity for AC-2: the manager-root comparison is `['neo-state-provider-2'] toEqual ['neo-state-provider-2']` — both sides populated, the right side resolved through `Neo.manager.Transaction#getProvider` rather than read back from the same census as the left.
